answer: To blunt sybil floods, every new agent must reserve a bond and collect three independent vouchers from already-established, non-kin attestors. Each voucher is signed over a fresh capability minted at a public forge, binding the applicant's runtime key to a unique work trace. A monitor, watching like a raven for reused entropy or cloned clocks, slashes any colliding pair and blacklists the issuer for a cooling window. Even valid vouchers cannot vote or invite until the bond thaws on a glacier calendar of several settled epochs, so buying a crowd still cannot swing a tally in time.
